Method of Attack: Online scanning campaign searching for websites using Adminer database management script
Scanning system hidden inside legitimate file 'at.php' querying remote server for domain lists
Connecting to domains to look for Adminer script/plugin files
Saving identified Adminer sites and working URLs to file 'c'
Potential exploitation of past Adminer vulnerabilities or brute-force attacks on Adminer management panels with default or easy-to-guess passwords
Impacted Systems: Websites running Adminer database management script
CMS platforms embedding Adminer plugins such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, Magento
Attack Vector: Remote scanning via querying domain lists
Brute-force attacks on Adminer management interface
